Name: (CP) (AT) Shardust's Pastel Fence Gate Flooring
Author: Shardust
Description:
[center][color=#e06666][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=5]
This is a Pastel version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2790]Fences Gate Flooring[/url] recolor mod. 

Features recolors and retextures for Fences, Gate, and Flooring. Also features a Hedge retexture in differenze sizes for the Fences, plus Foliage, Flowers, and Snow decor overlays, all in Pastels. [/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#e06666][size=5][b]Requirements and how to Install[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=5]Either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (and optionally [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make changes in-game) or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
(The AT version does not have the Foliage/Flowers/Snow decors due to the framework's limitations.) 

Download the version you prefer in your game's Mods folder, make sure you also have the right framework for it installed, and enjoy![/size][/color][/center]
